router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["launch"])


def get_plan(session: Session, plan_id: int) -> Plan:
    plan = session.get(Plan, plan_id)
    if plan is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that launch plan.")
    return plan


@router.get("/practice-mode")
def practice_mode(integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    return {"practice": integ.fake}


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/names")
def name_ideas(business_id: int, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
               claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
               integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> list[dict]:
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    try:
        quotes = find_names(claude, integ.availability, profile, fixture=namer_fixture(b.description))
    except NamerError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=str(e)) from e
    except ClaudeBudgetExceeded as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Our assistant has reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.") from e
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail="Checking real website names isn't switched on yet. "
                            "You can launch on the free address for now.") from e
    audit.record(session, actor="namer", action="name_ideas", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail=", ".join(q.domain for q in quotes))
    return [{"domain": q.domain, "price_usd": q.price_usd} for q in quotes]


class PlanRequest(BaseModel):
    mode: Literal["sandbox", "full"]
    domain: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=63)


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/plans", status_code=201)
def create_plan(business_id: int, body: PlanRequest, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    try:
        plan = build_plan(session, settings, integ, b, mode=body.mode, domain=body.domain)
    except PlanError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(e)) from e
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail="Launching on your own name isn't switched on yet.") from e
    return plan_out(plan)


@router.get("/plans/{plan_id}")
def read_plan(plan_id: int, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
              session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    out = plan_out(plan)
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    out["site_url"] = (f"https://{plan.site_host}/" if plan.mode == "full"
                       else site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b and b.subdomain else None)
    out["approvals"] = [{"action": a.action, "target": a.target, "amount_usd": a.amount_usd,
                         "approved_by": a.approved_by, "used": a.used_at is not None}
                        for a in session.exec(select(Approval).where(Approval.plan_id == plan.id)).all()]
    return out


class ApproveRequest(BaseModel):
    approved_by: str = Field(default="owner", min_length=1, max_length=80)


def _start(background: BackgroundTasks, session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, plan: Plan) -> None:
    background.add_task(run_plan, session.get_bind(), settings, integ, plan.id)


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/approve")
def approve_plan(plan_id: int, body: ApproveRequest, background: BackgroundTasks,
                 settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    if plan.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This plan was already approved.")
    running = active_plan(session, plan.business_id)
    if running is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Another launch is already running for this business.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status = "approved"
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/resume")
def resume_plan(plan_id: int, background: BackgroundTasks, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    if plan.status not in ("failed", "blocked"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only a stopped launch can be resumed.")
    reset_for_resume(session, plan)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="resume_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=plan.business_id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/plans")
def list_plans(business_id: int, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> list[dict]:
    get_business(session, business_id)
    rows = session.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == business_id).order_by(Plan.id.desc())).all()
    return [{"id": p.id, "mode": p.mode, "site_host": p.site_host, "status": p.status,
             "total_cost_usd": p.total_cost_usd, "steps": [s["status"] for s in json.loads(p.steps_json)]} for p in rows]

"""Checker (code only): proves a finished launch works (SPEC §6).

Checks: site points to the server (asked of the AUTHORITATIVE nameservers via
`integ.dns`), site opens over HTTPS with a valid certificate, email settings
(MX, SPF, DKIM, DMARC — full launches only; sandbox uses the app mailbox), a
real test order arrives, and the launch finished cleanly. Each result is stored
as a CheckResult row and an AuditEvent.
"""

import json
from dataclasses import dataclass

from sqlmodel import Session

from app import audit
from app.agents.executor import Ctx
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.godaddy.email import TITAN_MX
from app.models import CheckResult
from app.sites.orders import place_order


@dataclass
class Outcome:
    check: str
    passed: bool
    plain: str  # one line for the seller
    detail: str = ""  # technical


def _txt(values: list[str]) -> list[str]:
    return [v.strip('"') for v in values]


def check_site_points(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    host, want = ctx.plan.site_host, ctx.settings.server_ip
    got = ctx.integ.dns.resolve(host, "A")
    ok = want in got
    return Outcome("site_points", ok, "Your address leads to your website." if ok else
                   "Your address doesn't lead to your website yet.", f"A {host} = {got or 'nothing'}; want {want}")


def check_https(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    r = ctx.integ.http.fetch(f"https://{ctx.plan.site_host}/")
    ok = r.ok and r.cert_valid
    plain = ("Your website opens securely (the padlock shows)." if ok else
             "Your website's security certificate isn't working yet." if not r.cert_valid else
             "Your website didn't open.")
    return Outcome("https", ok, plain, f"status={r.status} cert_valid={r.cert_valid} {r.error}".strip())


def check_email_mx(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    got = ctx.integ.dns.resolve(ctx.plan.zone, "MX")
    hosts = {v.split()[-1].rstrip(".") for v in got}
    ok = all(h in hosts for _, h in TITAN_MX)
    return Outcome("email_mx", ok, "Emails to your address reach your mailbox." if ok else
                   "Emails sent to your address can't reach your mailbox.", f"MX = {got or 'nothing'}")


def check_email_spf(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    got = _txt(ctx.integ.dns.resolve(ctx.plan.zone, "TXT"))
    ok = any(v.startswith("v=spf1") and "include:spf.titan.email" in v for v in got)
    return Outcome("email_spf", ok, "Your mailbox is allowed to send email for you." if ok else
                   "Your emails may land in spam: the sending permission is missing.", f"TXT @ = {got or 'nothing'}")


def check_email_dkim(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    name = next((c["name"] for c in ctx.changes if c["name"].endswith("._domainkey")), "titan1._domainkey")
    got = _txt(ctx.integ.dns.resolve(f"{name}.{ctx.plan.zone}", "TXT"))
    ok = any(v.startswith("v=DKIM1") and "p=" in v for v in got)
    return Outcome("email_dkim", ok, "Your emails are signed so customers can trust them." if ok else
                   "Your emails aren't signed, so they may land in spam.", f"TXT {name} = {got or 'nothing'}")


def check_email_dmarc(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    got = _txt(ctx.integ.dns.resolve(f"_dmarc.{ctx.plan.zone}", "TXT"))
    ok = any(v.startswith("v=DMARC1") for v in got)
    return Outcome("email_dmarc", ok, "Fake emails in your name will be treated as spam." if ok else
                   "Order emails could land in spam: a protection setting is missing.", f"TXT _dmarc = {got or 'nothing'}")


def check_test_order(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    """Place a real order through the seller's order code, then look for it in the demo inbox."""
    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(ctx.business.profile_json)
    first = profile.products[0]
    data = {"customer_name": "LaunchWitness test", "customer_phone": "0000000000",
            "note": "Automatic test order from your launch check. No action needed.",
            "items": [{"name": first.name, "qty": 1, "price_inr": first.price_inr}], "total_inr": first.price_inr}
    order = place_order(ctx.session, ctx.integ.mailer, business=ctx.business, profile=profile, data=data,
                        mail_to=ctx.plan.mailbox, is_test=True)
    if order.email_status != "sent":
        return Outcome("test_order", False, "We couldn't send a test order email.", f"order #{order.id} email failed")
    for i in range(3):
        if ctx.integ.inbox.find(subject_contains=f"(#{order.id})"):
            return Outcome("test_order", True, "A test order arrived in your inbox.", f"order #{order.id} found")
        if i < 2:
            ctx.integ.sleep(20)
    return Outcome("test_order", False, "A test order was sent but hasn't arrived in your inbox.",
                   f"order #{order.id} not found in {ctx.plan.mailbox}")


def check_launch_clean(ctx: Ctx) -> Outcome:
    steps = json.loads(ctx.plan.steps_json)
    bad = [s["title"] for s in steps if s["status"] not in ("done", "skipped")]
    ok = ctx.plan.status == "done" and not bad
    return Outcome("launch_clean", ok, "Every launch step finished." if ok else
                   "Some launch steps didn't finish.", f"plan {ctx.plan.status}; unfinished: {bad}")


CHECKS = {
    "site_points": check_site_points,
    "https": check_https,
    "email_mx": check_email_mx,
    "email_spf": check_email_spf,
    "email_dkim": check_email_dkim,
    "email_dmarc": check_email_dmarc,
    "test_order": check_test_order,
    "launch_clean": check_launch_clean,
}


def checks_for(ctx: Ctx) -> list[str]:
    if ctx.plan.mode == "full":
        return list(CHECKS)
    return ["site_points", "https", "test_order", "launch_clean"]


def run_check(ctx: Ctx, name: str, attempt: int = 0) -> Outcome:
    try:
        out = CHECKS[name](ctx)
    except Exception as e:  # a check that crashes is a failed check, never a crash of the launch
        out = Outcome(name, False, "We couldn't complete this check.", f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:300])
    save(ctx.session, ctx, out, attempt)
    return out


def save(session: Session, ctx: Ctx, out: Outcome, attempt: int) -> None:
    session.add(CheckResult(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, check=out.check, passed=out.passed,
                            detail=json.dumps({"plain": out.plain, "detail": out.detail}), attempt=attempt))
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="checker", action=f"check_{out.check}", target=ctx.plan.site_host,
                 result="pass" if out.passed else "fail", business_id=ctx.business.id,
                 detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {out.detail}"[:500])


def run_all(ctx: Ctx) -> list[Outcome]:
    return [run_check(ctx, name) for name in checks_for(ctx)]
"""Doctor: Claude (cheap model) explains ONE failed check in one plain sentence and
picks a fix_id from the fixed playbook. Code validates the choice, applies it and
re-checks; at most 3 attempts per check. Anything outside the playbook (or not a
sensible fix for that check) is refused and logged — the model never acts alone.
"""

from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from app import audit
from app.agents.checker import Outcome, run_check
from app.agents.claude_client import Claude, ClaudeBadJson, ClaudeError
from app.agents.executor import Ctx, StepFailed
from app.agents.playbook import FIXES_FOR, PLAYBOOK, apply_fix

MAX_ATTEMPTS = 3
DIAGNOSIS_SCHEMA = {
    "type": "object",
    "additionalProperties": False,
    "required": ["plain_explanation", "fix_id"],
    "properties": {"plain_explanation": {"type": "string"}, "fix_id": {"type": "string", "enum": sorted(PLAYBOOK)}},
}
SYSTEM = f"""You help a small shop owner whose new website failed one launch check.
Explain the problem in ONE short sentence of plain English (no technical words like MX, DNS, TXT, SPF, DKIM, DMARC),
saying what it means for her customers. Then choose exactly one fix_id from this list: {", ".join(sorted(PLAYBOOK))}.
Return ONLY JSON: {{"plain_explanation": "...", "fix_id": "..."}}"""


class DoctorRefused(Exception):
    pass


@dataclass
class Diagnosis:
    plain_explanation: str
    fix_id: str


@dataclass
class RepairResult:
    check: str
    fixed: bool
    attempts: list[dict] = field(default_factory=list)  # [{explanation, fix_id, applied, message, passed}]
    final: Outcome | None = None


def diagnose(claude: Claude, ctx: Ctx, failed: Outcome) -> Diagnosis:
    user = f"Failed check: {failed.check}\nWhat we saw: {failed.plain}\nTechnical detail: {failed.detail}"
    data = claude.ask_json(fixture=f"doctor_{failed.check}", tier="cheap", system=SYSTEM, user=user,
                           schema=DIAGNOSIS_SCHEMA, max_tokens=200)
    explanation = str(data.get("plain_explanation", "")).strip()[:300]
    fix_id = str(data.get("fix_id", "")).strip()
    if fix_id not in PLAYBOOK or fix_id not in FIXES_FOR.get(failed.check, set()):
        audit.record(ctx.session, actor="doctor", action="diagnose", target=failed.check, result="refused",
                     business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"fix_id {fix_id!r} not allowed for {failed.check}")
        raise DoctorRefused(fix_id)
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="doctor", action="diagnose", target=failed.check, result="ok",
                 business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"{fix_id}: {explanation}")
    return Diagnosis(explanation or failed.plain, fix_id)


def repair(claude: Claude, ctx: Ctx, failed: Outcome) -> RepairResult:
    result = RepairResult(failed.check, False, final=failed)
    for attempt in range(1, MAX_ATTEMPTS + 1):
        try:
            d = diagnose(claude, ctx, failed)
        except DoctorRefused as e:
            result.attempts.append({"explanation": failed.plain, "fix_id": str(e), "applied": False,
                                    "message": "That fix isn't allowed, so nothing was changed.", "passed": False})
            continue
        except (ClaudeBadJson, ClaudeError, FileNotFoundError) as e:
            result.attempts.append({"explanation": failed.plain, "fix_id": "", "applied": False,
                                    "message": "Our assistant couldn't look at this right now.", "passed": False})
            audit.record(ctx.session, actor="doctor", action="diagnose", target=failed.check, result="failed",
                         business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=type(e).__name__)
            break
        try:
            message = apply_fix(ctx, d.fix_id)
            applied = True
        except StepFailed as e:
            message, applied = e.message, False
        failed = run_check(ctx, failed.check, attempt)
        result.attempts.append({"explanation": d.plain_explanation, "fix_id": d.fix_id, "applied": applied,
                                "message": message, "passed": failed.passed})
        result.final = failed
        if failed.passed:
            result.fixed = True
            break
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="doctor", action="repair", target=result.check,
                 result="fixed" if result.fixed else "gave_up", business_id=ctx.business.id,
                 detail=f"{len(result.attempts)} attempt(s)")
    return result
"""Launch API: name ideas, plan (approval card), approve, step log, resume."""

import json
from typing import Annotated, Literal

from fastapi import APIRouter, BackgroundTasks, Depends, HTTPException
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.claude_client import Claude, ClaudeBudgetExceeded
from app.agents.executor import reset_for_resume, run_plan
from app.agents.namer import NamerError, find_names, namer_fixture
from app.agents.planner import PlanError, active_plan, build_plan, plan_out
from app.agents.reader import Profile
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.db import get_session
from app.integrations import Integrations, get_integrations
from app.models import Approval, Business, Plan
from app.routers.businesses import get_business, get_claude
from app.sites.hosts import site_url

router = APIRouter(prefix="/api", tags=["launch"])


def get_plan(session: Session, plan_id: int) -> Plan:
    plan = session.get(Plan, plan_id)
    if plan is None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail="We couldn't find that launch plan.")
    return plan


@router.get("/practice-mode")
def practice_mode(integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    return {"practice": integ.fake}


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/names")
def name_ideas(business_id: int, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
               claude: Annotated[Claude, Depends(get_claude)],
               integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> list[dict]:
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    profile = Profile.model_validate_json(b.profile_json)
    try:
        quotes = find_names(claude, integ.availability, profile, fixture=namer_fixture(b.description))
    except NamerError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=502, detail=str(e)) from e
    except ClaudeBudgetExceeded as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=503, detail="Our assistant has reached today's limit. Please try again tomorrow.") from e
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail="Checking real website names isn't switched on yet. "
                            "You can launch on the free address for now.") from e
    audit.record(session, actor="namer", action="name_ideas", target=f"business:{b.id}", result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail=", ".join(q.domain for q in quotes))
    return [{"domain": q.domain, "price_usd": q.price_usd} for q in quotes]


class PlanRequest(BaseModel):
    mode: Literal["sandbox", "full"]
    domain: str | None = Field(default=None, max_length=63)


@router.post("/businesses/{business_id}/plans", status_code=201)
def create_plan(business_id: int, body: PlanRequest, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    b = get_business(session, business_id)
    try:
        plan = build_plan(session, settings, integ, b, mode=body.mode, domain=body.domain)
    except PlanError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=422, detail=str(e)) from e
    except NotImplementedError as e:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=501, detail="Launching on your own name isn't switched on yet.") from e
    return plan_out(plan)


@router.get("/plans/{plan_id}")
def read_plan(plan_id: int, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
              session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    out = plan_out(plan)
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
    out["site_url"] = (f"https://{plan.site_host}/" if plan.mode == "full"
                       else site_url(b.subdomain, settings) if b and b.subdomain else None)
    out["approvals"] = [{"action": a.action, "target": a.target, "amount_usd": a.amount_usd,
                         "approved_by": a.approved_by, "used": a.used_at is not None}
                        for a in session.exec(select(Approval).where(Approval.plan_id == plan.id)).all()]
    return out


class ApproveRequest(BaseModel):
    approved_by: str = Field(default="owner", min_length=1, max_length=80)


def _start(background: BackgroundTasks, session: Session, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, plan: Plan) -> None:
    background.add_task(run_plan, session.get_bind(), settings, integ, plan.id)


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/approve")
def approve_plan(plan_id: int, body: ApproveRequest, background: BackgroundTasks,
                 settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                 session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                 integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    if plan.status != "draft":
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="This plan was already approved.")
    running = active_plan(session, plan.business_id)
    if running is not None:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Another launch is already running for this business.")
    b = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)

    if plan.mode == "full":
        # Re-check the price now: never approve a different amount than the card showed.
        if not integ.godaddy.is_owned(plan.zone):
            quote = integ.availability.check([plan.zone])[0]
            if not quote.available or quote.price_usd is None or float(quote.price_usd) > plan.total_cost_usd:
                raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="The price or availability changed. Please review the plan again.")
        clash = session.exec(select(Business).where(Business.domain == plan.zone, Business.id != b.id)).first()
        if clash is not None:
            raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="That name is already used by another business here.")
        b.domain = plan.zone  # from now on the domain is "in the app's database" for this business
        session.add(b)
        if plan.total_cost_usd > 0:
            session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="buy_domain", target=plan.zone,
                                 amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    session.add(Approval(business_id=b.id, plan_id=plan.id, action="launch", target=plan.site_host,
                         amount_usd=plan.total_cost_usd, approved_by=body.approved_by))
    plan.status = "approved"
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="approve_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=b.id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}, ${plan.total_cost_usd:.2f}, by {body.approved_by}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.post("/plans/{plan_id}/resume")
def resume_plan(plan_id: int, background: BackgroundTasks, settings: Annotated[Settings, Depends(get_settings)],
                session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)],
                integ: Annotated[Integrations, Depends(get_integrations)]) -> dict:
    plan = get_plan(session, plan_id)
    if plan.status not in ("failed", "blocked"):
        raise HTTPException(status_code=409, detail="Only a stopped launch can be resumed.")
    reset_for_resume(session, plan)
    audit.record(session, actor="owner", action="resume_plan", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                 business_id=plan.business_id, detail=f"plan #{plan.id}")
    _start(background, session, settings, integ, plan)
    return {"ok": True, "plan_id": plan.id}


@router.get("/businesses/{business_id}/plans")
def list_plans(business_id: int, session: Annotated[Session, Depends(get_session)]) -> list[dict]:
    get_business(session, business_id)
    rows = session.exec(select(Plan).where(Plan.business_id == business_id).order_by(Plan.id.desc())).all()
    return [{"id": p.id, "mode": p.mode, "site_host": p.site_host, "status": p.status,
             "total_cost_usd": p.total_cost_usd, "steps": [s["status"] for s in json.loads(p.steps_json)]} for p in rows]

def get_settings() -> Settings:

Here's the plan for Session 3. I've read CLAUDE.md, PROGRESS.md, the M4 section of BUILD_PLAN.md, SPEC §6, §7 and §9, and the current checker, doctor, playbook, launch router and frontend.

**What I'll do (M4 against the fakes, $0 spend, no live calls)**

1. **Owner link and the email-plan line** (your two answers, recorded under Decisions)
   - Each business gets a random owner token. Only its SHA-256 hash is stored.
   - The token is needed for everything except the public seller site and the sample inputs: edit, names, plan, approve, resume, report, run checks and orders (orders hold customers' phone numbers).
   - `GET /api/businesses` (which lists every business) becomes admin-only.
   - After "describe", the app shows the owner link once, with a plain-English "Save this link, it's the only way back in" message and a copy button. The frontend keeps the token in localStorage and sends it as a header.
   - The approval card gets a separate line: "Email plan, bought separately on GoDaddy, about $X/year (estimate)". X comes from a new setting `EMAIL_PLAN_ESTIMATE_USD`. The spend guard stays as it is: it only covers the domain.
   - The review screen gets one new field: "Your personal email, for alerts".
2. **Launch check, Doctor and report** (AC1, AC2)
   - A new `CheckRun` table records each run: launch, manual or monitor.
   - When a launch finishes, the checks run automatically. Any failed check goes to the Doctor, which uses the existing playbook, at most 3 attempts, all audited.
   - `POST …/checks` is the "Run checks now" button.
   - New report page:
     - the headline "Your business is ready for customers", or a plain-English list of what's left
     - each check with its result and time
     - the Doctor's sentences and what was fixed
     - the audit log in an expandable "Details" area
3. **Demo fault toggle** (AC2)
   - `ADMIN_TOKEN`-only endpoint plus a small admin switch on the report. The switch appears only after the admin token has been entered on `#/admin`.
   - It arms a one-time fault: before the next check run, DMARC (or MX) is deleted through the same guarded DNS code, logged as `demo_fault`. Then the check fails, the Doctor explains, the fix is applied and the re-check comes back green.
4. **Light monitoring with APScheduler** (AC4)
   - Every 15 minutes: site and HTTPS. Daily: DNS and email settings still match the plan, plus days left on the certificate and the domain.
   - On a failure: re-check once a minute later. If it still fails, the Doctor tries a playbook fix. If it's still broken, an email goes to the owner's personal email through Mailer.
   - Expiry warnings at 30, 7 and 1 days, each sent once (an `Alert` table prevents repeats).
   - To make this testable, the fakes gain certificate and domain expiry dates.
   - `MONITOR_ENABLED` setting: the scheduler only starts in the app's startup hook, which tests never run, and tests also force it off. Tests call the job functions directly and check that the jobs are registered.
5. **Guards for the live link** (for judges later)
   - Per-visitor launch limit: `LAUNCHES_PER_VISITOR_PER_DAY`, default 3, keyed on a hash of the client IP. With Caddy in front, I use the last `X-Forwarded-For` value. Admin bypasses it.
   - Practice only on the public path: see question B.
6. **Tests, browser check and wrap-up**

"""Executor (code only): runs an APPROVED plan's steps in order.

Guards, checked on every DNS write (`write_change`):
1. a DnsBackup for this plan exists (taken by the backup step, before the first write);
2. the zone is in the app's database for THIS business: the seller's own
   `Business.domain`, or APP_DOMAIN but only for the business's own subdomain label;
3. writes are scoped to one (type, name), never a whole-zone replace.
Purchases go through the spend guard. Every step writes an AuditEvent. The step
log lives in `Plan.steps_json` (the UI polls it). A failed/blocked plan can be
resumed: finished steps are skipped.
"""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.planner import DKIM_PENDING
from app.config import Settings
from app.godaddy.client import PurchaseNotSupported
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import Approval, Business, DnsBackup, Plan, utcnow
from app.safety.spend_guard import PurchaseBlocked, authorize_purchase, mark_used

DNS_POLLS = 10
DNS_POLL_SECONDS = 30
MAILBOX_CREATE_TRIES = 3
MAILBOX_POLLS = 12
MAILBOX_POLL_SECONDS = 10


class StepFailed(Exception):
    """`message` is plain English for the seller; `detail` is technical."""

    status = "failed"

    def __init__(self, message: str, detail: str = ""):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message, self.detail = message, detail


class StepBlocked(StepFailed):
    status = "blocked"


class DomainRefused(StepFailed):
    status = "failed"


@dataclass
class Ctx:
    session: Session
    settings: Settings
    integ: Integrations
    plan: Plan
    business: Business

    @property
    def changes(self) -> list[dict]:
        return json.loads(self.plan.dns_json)


# ---------- guards ----------

def assert_can_write(ctx: Ctx, zone: str, name: str) -> None:
    """Refuse any DNS write outside this business's own domain/subdomain (re-read from DB)."""
    ctx.session.refresh(ctx.business)
    b, app_domain = ctx.business, ctx.settings.app_domain.lower()
    zone = zone.lower()
    ok = (
        zone == ctx.plan.zone.lower()
        and (
            (zone == app_domain and b.subdomain is not None and name == b.subdomain)
            or (zone != app_domain and b.domain is not None and zone == b.domain.lower())
        )
    )
    if not ok:
        audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{name} @ {zone}", result="refused",
                     business_id=b.id, detail="zone/name not owned by this business in the app database")
        raise DomainRefused(f"Stopped: this launch may only change settings for {ctx.plan.site_host}. Nothing was changed.",
                            f"refused write to {name} on {zone}")


def latest_backup(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> DnsBackup | None:
    return session.exec(select(DnsBackup).where(DnsBackup.plan_id == plan.id).order_by(DnsBackup.id.desc())).first()


def write_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict, after: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    if latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan) is None:
        raise StepFailed("Stopped: we couldn't save a copy of your settings first, so nothing was changed.",
                         "no DnsBackup for this plan")
    records = after if after is not None else ch["after"]
    ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], records)
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=json.dumps([r.get("data") for r in records])[:500])


def restore_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict) -> None:
    """Put one (type, name) back exactly as it was in the plan's backup (delete if it didn't exist)."""
    backup = latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan)
    if backup is None:
        raise StepFailed("There's no saved copy to undo from.", "no DnsBackup")
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    before = [r for r in json.loads(backup.records_json) if r["type"] == ch["type"] and r["name"] == ch["name"]]
    if before:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], before)
    else:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.delete_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"])
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_restore", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"from backup #{backup.id}")


# ---------- steps ----------

def step_backup_dns(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    records = ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(ctx.plan.zone)
    b = DnsBackup(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, domain=ctx.plan.zone,
                  records_json=json.dumps(records))
    ctx.session.add(b)
    ctx.session.commit()
    return f"Saved {len(records)} settings."


def step_point_site(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    for ch in ctx.changes:
        if ch["type"] == "A":
            write_change(ctx, ch)
    return "Done."


def step_get_domain(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    domain, cost = ctx.plan.zone, ctx.plan.total_cost_usd
    if ctx.integ.godaddy.is_owned(domain):
        return f"{domain} is in your GoDaddy account — using it."
    try:
        approval = authorize_purchase(ctx.session, ctx.settings, business_id=ctx.business.id, action="buy_domain",
                                      target=domain, cost_usd=cost, actor="executor")
    except PurchaseBlocked as e:
        raise StepBlocked(
            f"Stopped before buying {domain}. Buying is switched off on this server, so nothing was bought and "
            f"no settings were changed. You can buy {domain} on godaddy.com yourself, then press Resume — "
            "we'll use the domain you own.",
            e.reason,
        ) from e
    try:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.purchase_domain(domain, cost)
    except PurchaseNotSupported as e:
        raise StepBlocked(f"Please buy {domain} on godaddy.com, then press Resume.", str(e)) from e
    mark_used(ctx.session, approval)
    return f"Bought {domain}."


def step_use_app_mailbox(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    if ctx.integ.mailbox.find(ctx.plan.mailbox) is None:
        raise StepFailed("The LaunchWitness inbox isn't set up yet, so we can't receive your orders.",
                         f"app mailbox {ctx.plan.mailbox} not found")
    return f"Orders will arrive at {ctx.plan.mailbox}."


def step_setup_mailbox(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    """Create or adopt; retry creation on failure; poll until ready. Never undone."""
    mb, address, sleep = ctx.integ.mailbox, ctx.plan.mailbox, ctx.integ.sleep
    adopted = mb.find(address) is not None
    if not adopted:
        last = ""
        for attempt in range(1, MAILBOX_CREATE_TRIES + 1):
            try:
                mb.create(address)
                break
            except Exception as e:  # provider busy etc.: retry with backoff
                last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="mailbox_create", target=address, result="retry",
                             business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {last}"[:300])
                sleep(2**attempt)
        else:
            raise StepFailed("The email service is busy and couldn't create your mailbox. Press Resume to try again.",
                             last)
    for _ in range(MAILBOX_POLLS):
        if mb.status(address) == "ready":
            return f"{'Using' if adopted else 'Created'} {address}; it's ready."
        sleep(MAILBOX_POLL_SECONDS)
    raise StepFailed("Your mailbox is still being set up. This can take a few minutes — press Resume to keep waiting.",
                     f"{address} not ready after {MAILBOX_POLLS} polls")


def step_email_records(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    for ch in ctx.changes:
        if ch["type"] == "A":
            continue
        after = ch["after"]
        if ch["deferred"] or any(r.get("data") == DKIM_PENDING for r in after):
            name, value = ctx.integ.mailbox.dkim(ctx.plan.zone)
            if name != ch["name"]:
                raise StepFailed("The email service gave an unexpected signing setting. Nothing more was changed.",
                                 f"DKIM name {name} != planned {ch['name']}")
            after = [{**r, "data": value} for r in after]
        write_change(ctx, ch, after)
    return "Email settings added."


def step_wait_dns(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    host, want = ctx.plan.site_host, ctx.settings.server_ip
    for i in range(DNS_POLLS):
        if want in ctx.integ.dns.resolve(host, "A"):
            return f"{host} now points to your website."
        if i < DNS_POLLS - 1:
            ctx.integ.sleep(DNS_POLL_SECONDS)
    raise StepFailed("The internet hasn't picked up the new address yet. This can take up to an hour — "
                     "press Resume to keep waiting.", f"A {host} != {want} after {DNS_POLLS} polls")


def step_go_live(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    ctx.business.status = "live"
    ctx.session.add(ctx.business)
    ctx.session.commit()
    return f"Your website is on at {ctx.plan.site_host}."


STEPS: dict[str, Callable[[Ctx], str]] = {
    "backup_dns": step_backup_dns,
    "point_site": step_point_site,
    "get_domain": step_get_domain,
    "use_app_mailbox": step_use_app_mailbox,
    "setup_mailbox": step_setup_mailbox,
    "email_records": step_email_records,
    "wait_dns": step_wait_dns,
    "go_live": step_go_live,
}


# ---------- runner ----------

def has_launch_approval(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> bool:
    return session.exec(select(Approval).where(Approval.plan_id == plan.id, Approval.action == "launch")).first() is not None


def _save_steps(session: Session, plan: Plan, steps: list[dict]) -> None:
    plan.steps_json = json.dumps(steps)
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()


def run_plan(engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, plan_id: int) -> str:
    """Run (or resume) a plan. Returns the final plan status."""
    with Session(engine) as session:
        plan = session.get(Plan, plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return "missing"
        business = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
        if not has_launch_approval(session, plan):
            audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="refused",
                         business_id=plan.business_id, detail="no owner approval")
            return plan.status
        ctx = Ctx(session, settings, integ, plan, business)
        plan.status = "running"
        steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
        _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
        audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="started",
                     business_id=business.id)

        for st in steps:
            if st["status"] in ("done", "skipped"):
                continue
            st.update(status="running", message="", started_at=utcnow().isoformat(), finished_at=None)
            _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
            try:
                message = STEPS[st["kind"]](ctx)
            except StepFailed as e:
                st.update(status=e.status, message=e.message, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
                plan.status = e.status
                _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
                audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host,
                             result=e.status, business_id=business.id, detail=(e.detail or e.message)[:500])
                return plan.status
            except Exception as e:  # unexpected: stop safely, keep details for the log
                st.update(status="failed", finished_at=utcnow().isoformat(),
                          message="Something went wrong while talking to GoDaddy. We stopped here; press Resume to try again.")
                plan.status = "failed"
                _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
                audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host,
                             result="failed", business_id=business.id, detail=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:500])
                return plan.status
            st.update(status="done", message=message, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
            _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
            audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                         business_id=business.id, detail=message[:500])

        plan.status = "done"
        _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
        audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="ok",
                     business_id=business.id)
        return plan.status


def reset_for_resume(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> None:
    steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
    for st in steps:
        if st["status"] in ("failed", "blocked", "running"):
            st.update(status="pending", message="")
    plan.status = "approved"
    _save_steps(session, plan, steps)

"""All outside services the launch engine uses, bundled so they can be swapped.

USE_FAKES=true (default): one shared in-memory "fake world" per process
(GoDaddy zones, availability, mailbox, authoritative DNS answering from the
fake zones, HTTP probe). Nothing real changes. USE_FAKES=false: real clients;
the parts not built yet raise NotImplementedError (see PROGRESS.md).
"""

import time
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from functools import lru_cache

from app.checks.dns_resolver import DnsResolver, ZoneBackedResolver
from app.checks.http_probe import FakeHttpProbe, HttpProbe, RealHttpProbe
from app.config import Settings, get_settings
from app.godaddy.availability import AvailabilityChecker, FakeAvailabilityChecker, GoDaddyAvailabilityChecker
from app.godaddy.client import FakeGoDaddyClient, GoDaddy, GoDaddyClient
from app.godaddy.email import FakeMailboxProvider, MailboxProvider, TitanMailboxProvider
from app.mail.imap import FakeInboxReader, ImapInboxReader, InboxReader
from app.mail.smtp import FakeMailer, Mailer, SmtpMailer


class DeliveringFakeMailer(FakeMailer):
    """Practice mode: 'sent' mail lands in the fake inbox, like a working mailbox would."""

    def __init__(self, inbox: FakeInboxReader, sender: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.inbox, self.sender, self.drop = inbox, sender, False

    def send(self, *, to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> str:
        message_id = super().send(to=to, subject=subject, body=body)
        if not self.drop:
            self.inbox.deliver(sender=self.sender, to=to, subject=subject, body=body)
        return message_id


@dataclass
class Integrations:
    godaddy: GoDaddy
    availability: AvailabilityChecker
    mailbox: MailboxProvider
    dns: DnsResolver  # must ask GoDaddy's AUTHORITATIVE nameservers, not a cache
    http: HttpProbe
    mailer: Mailer  # used by the launch check's test order
    inbox: InboxReader  # demo mailbox, to prove the test order arrived
    sleep: Callable[[float], None] = field(default=time.sleep)
    fake: bool = False


def fake_integrations(settings: Settings, sleep: Callable[[float], None] | None = None) -> Integrations:
    gd = FakeGoDaddyClient(owned={settings.app_domain})
    inbox = FakeInboxReader()
    return Integrations(
        godaddy=gd,
        availability=FakeAvailabilityChecker(),
        mailbox=FakeMailboxProvider(existing={settings.smtp_user}),
        dns=ZoneBackedResolver(gd),
        http=FakeHttpProbe(settings),
        mailer=DeliveringFakeMailer(inbox, settings.smtp_user),
        inbox=inbox,
        sleep=sleep or (lambda _s: None),
        fake=True,
    )


def real_integrations(settings: Settings) -> Integrations:
    from app.checks.dns_resolver import RealDnsResolver

    return Integrations(
        godaddy=GoDaddyClient(settings),
        availability=GoDaddyAvailabilityChecker(),
        mailbox=TitanMailboxProvider(),
        # TODO(real): pass GoDaddy's authoritative nameserver IPs (ns*.domaincontrol.com) for the zone.
        dns=RealDnsResolver(),
        http=RealHttpProbe(),
        mailer=SmtpMailer(settings),
        inbox=ImapInboxReader(settings),
    )


@lru_cache
def _shared_fakes() -> Integrations:
    return fake_integrations(get_settings())


def get_integrations() -> Integrations:
    """FastAPI dependency. Tests override this."""
    settings = get_settings()
    return _shared_fakes() if settings.use_fakes else real_integrations(settings)
"""Fetch a URL over HTTPS and report status + certificate validity (for launch checks)."""

import ssl
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import httpx

from app.config import Settings


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProbeResult:
    ok: bool  # HTTP 2xx/3xx over HTTPS with a valid certificate
    status: int | None
    cert_valid: bool
    body_snippet: str = ""
    error: str = ""


class HttpProbe(Protocol):
    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult: ...


class RealHttpProbe:
    def __init__(self, timeout: float = 10.0, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None):
        self._http = httpx.Client(timeout=timeout, follow_redirects=True, transport=transport)

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult:
        try:
            r = self._http.get(url)
        except httpx.ConnectError as e:
            cert_bad = isinstance(e.__cause__, ssl.SSLError) or "CERTIFICATE" in str(e).upper()
            return ProbeResult(False, None, not cert_bad, error=type(e).__name__)
        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, False, error=type(e).__name__)
        https = urlsplit(str(r.url)).scheme == "https"
        return ProbeResult(https and r.status_code < 400, r.status_code, https, r.text[:2000])


class FakeHttpProbe:
    """Practice mode: a site 'is up with a valid certificate' when its host is in the
    fake DNS and not listed in `broken_cert` / `down`."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None):
        self.down: set[str] = set()
        self.broken_cert: set[str] = set()
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult:
        self.calls.append(url)
        host = urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
        if host in self.down:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, True, error="ConnectTimeout")
        if host in self.broken_cert:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, False, error="certificate verify failed")
        return ProbeResult(True, 200, True, "<html>ok</html>")
"""GoDaddy REST API wrapper (Domains + DNS). OTE sandbox by default.

DNS writes are always scoped to ONE (type, name) pair (`set_records` /
`delete_records`), never a whole-zone replace, so a launch can't wipe records
it didn't plan. Purchases are not implemented in the real client: they are done
by the owner on godaddy.com, and any future code path must go through
`app.safety.spend_guard.authorize_purchase` first.
"""

from typing import Protocol

import httpx

from app.config import Settings

BASE_URLS = {
    "ote": "https://api.ote-godaddy.com",
    "prod": "https://api.godaddy.com",
}

DnsRecord = dict  # {"type": "A", "name": "@", "data": "1.2.3.4", "ttl": 600, "priority"?: 10}


class PurchaseNotSupported(RuntimeError):
    pass


class GoDaddy(Protocol):
    env: str

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict: ...
    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool: ...
    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]: ...
    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None: ...
    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None: ...
    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict: ...


class GoDaddyClient:
    """Real client. `env` comes from GODADDY_ENV; prod only when set explicitly."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None):
        self.env = settings.godaddy_env
        if self.env == "prod":
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_api_key, settings.godaddy_api_secret
        else:
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_ote_api_key, settings.godaddy_ote_api_secret
        self.base_url = BASE_URLS[self.env]
        self._http = httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"sso-key {key.get_secret_value()}:{secret.get_secret_value()}",
                "Accept": "application/json",
            },
            timeout=20.0,
            transport=transport,
        )

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        r = self._http.get("/v1/domains/available", params={"domain": domain})
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool:
        """True if the domain is in this GoDaddy account. TODO(real): verify against prod account."""
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}")
        if r.status_code == 404:
            return False
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json().get("status", "").upper() in ("ACTIVE", "PENDING_DNS_ACTIVE", "")

    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]:
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records")
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None:
        """Replace all records of one type+name (PUT /v1/domains/{d}/records/{type}/{name})."""
        body = [{k: v for k, v in rec.items() if k not in ("type", "name")} for rec in records]
        r = self._http.put(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}", json=body)
        r.raise_for_status()

    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:
        r = self._http.delete(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}")
        if r.status_code != 404:
            r.raise_for_status()

    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict:
        raise PurchaseNotSupported("Domains are bought by the owner on godaddy.com; the app only adopts them.")

        self.calls: list[tuple] = []
        self.fail_next: dict[str, int] = {}  # method name -> number of upcoming calls that raise

    def _maybe_fail(self, method: str) -> None:
        if self.fail_next.get(method, 0) > 0:
            self.fail_next[method] -= 1
            raise RuntimeError(f"fake {method} failure")

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        self.calls.append(("check_availability", domain))
        if domain in self.available and domain not in self.owned:
            return {"domain": domain, "available": True, "price_usd": self.available[domain]}
        return {"domain": domain, "available": False}

    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool:
        self.calls.append(("is_owned", domain))
        return domain in self.owned

    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]:
        self.calls.append(("get_records", domain))
        self._maybe_fail("get_records")
        return [dict(r) for r in self.zones.get(domain, [])]

    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("set_records", domain, rtype, name))
        self._maybe_fail("set_records")
        keep = [r for r in self.zones.get(domain, []) if not (r["type"] == rtype and r["name"] == name)]
        self.zones[domain] = keep + [{**dict(r), "type": rtype, "name": name} for r in records]

    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:
        self.calls.append(("delete_records", domain, rtype, name))
        self.zones[domain] = [r for r in self.zones.get(domain, []) if not (r["type"] == rtype and r["name"] == name)]

    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict:
        self.calls.append(("purchase_domain", domain, price_usd))
        self.owned.add(domain)
        return {"domain": domain, "price_usd": price_usd, "order_id": f"fake-{len(self.owned)}"}

    def writes(self) -> list[tuple]:
        return [c for c in self.calls if c[0] in ("set_records", "delete_records")]

"""Executor (code only): runs an APPROVED plan's steps in order.

Guards, checked on every DNS write (`write_change`):
1. a DnsBackup for this plan exists (taken by the backup step, before the first write);
2. the zone is in the app's database for THIS business: the seller's own
   `Business.domain`, or APP_DOMAIN but only for the business's own subdomain label;
3. writes are scoped to one (type, name), never a whole-zone replace.
Purchases go through the spend guard. Every step writes an AuditEvent. The step
log lives in `Plan.steps_json` (the UI polls it). A failed/blocked plan can be
resumed: finished steps are skipped.
"""

import json
from collections.abc import Callable
from dataclasses import dataclass

from sqlalchemy.engine import Engine
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app import audit
from app.agents.planner import DKIM_PENDING
from app.config import Settings
from app.godaddy.client import PurchaseNotSupported
from app.integrations import Integrations
from app.models import Approval, Business, DnsBackup, Plan, utcnow
from app.safety.spend_guard import PurchaseBlocked, authorize_purchase, mark_used

DNS_POLLS = 10
DNS_POLL_SECONDS = 30
MAILBOX_CREATE_TRIES = 3
MAILBOX_POLLS = 12
MAILBOX_POLL_SECONDS = 10


class StepFailed(Exception):
    """`message` is plain English for the seller; `detail` is technical."""

    status = "failed"

    def __init__(self, message: str, detail: str = ""):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.message, self.detail = message, detail


class StepBlocked(StepFailed):
    status = "blocked"


class DomainRefused(StepFailed):
    status = "failed"


@dataclass
class Ctx:
    session: Session
    settings: Settings
    integ: Integrations
    plan: Plan
    business: Business

    @property
    def changes(self) -> list[dict]:
        return json.loads(self.plan.dns_json)


# ---------- guards ----------

def assert_can_write(ctx: Ctx, zone: str, name: str) -> None:
    """Refuse any DNS write outside this business's own domain/subdomain (re-read from DB)."""
    ctx.session.refresh(ctx.business)
    b, app_domain = ctx.business, ctx.settings.app_domain.lower()
    zone = zone.lower()
    ok = (
        zone == ctx.plan.zone.lower()
        and (
            (zone == app_domain and b.subdomain is not None and name == b.subdomain)
            or (zone != app_domain and b.domain is not None and zone == b.domain.lower())
        )
    )
    if not ok:
        audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{name} @ {zone}", result="refused",
                     business_id=b.id, detail="zone/name not owned by this business in the app database")
        raise DomainRefused(f"Stopped: this launch may only change settings for {ctx.plan.site_host}. Nothing was changed.",
                            f"refused write to {name} on {zone}")


def latest_backup(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> DnsBackup | None:
    return session.exec(select(DnsBackup).where(DnsBackup.plan_id == plan.id).order_by(DnsBackup.id.desc())).first()


def write_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict, after: list[dict] | None = None) -> None:
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    if latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan) is None:
        raise StepFailed("Stopped: we couldn't save a copy of your settings first, so nothing was changed.",
                         "no DnsBackup for this plan")
    records = after if after is not None else ch["after"]
    ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], records)
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_write", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=json.dumps([r.get("data") for r in records])[:500])


def restore_change(ctx: Ctx, ch: dict) -> None:
    """Put one (type, name) back exactly as it was in the plan's backup (delete if it didn't exist)."""
    backup = latest_backup(ctx.session, ctx.plan)
    if backup is None:
        raise StepFailed("There's no saved copy to undo from.", "no DnsBackup")
    assert_can_write(ctx, ch["zone"], ch["name"])
    before = [r for r in json.loads(backup.records_json) if r["type"] == ch["type"] and r["name"] == ch["name"]]
    if before:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.set_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"], before)
    else:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.delete_records(ch["zone"], ch["type"], ch["name"])
    audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="dns_restore", target=f"{ch['type']} {ch['name']} @ {ch['zone']}",
                 result="ok", business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"from backup #{backup.id}")


# ---------- steps ----------

def step_backup_dns(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    records = ctx.integ.godaddy.get_records(ctx.plan.zone)
    b = DnsBackup(business_id=ctx.business.id, plan_id=ctx.plan.id, domain=ctx.plan.zone,
                  records_json=json.dumps(records))
    ctx.session.add(b)
    ctx.session.commit()
    return f"Saved {len(records)} settings."


def step_point_site(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    for ch in ctx.changes:
        if ch["type"] == "A":
            write_change(ctx, ch)
    return "Done."


def step_get_domain(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    domain, cost = ctx.plan.zone, ctx.plan.total_cost_usd
    if ctx.integ.godaddy.is_owned(domain):
        return f"{domain} is in your GoDaddy account — using it."
    try:
        approval = authorize_purchase(ctx.session, ctx.settings, business_id=ctx.business.id, action="buy_domain",
                                      target=domain, cost_usd=cost, actor="executor")
    except PurchaseBlocked as e:
        raise StepBlocked(
            f"Stopped before buying {domain}. Buying is switched off on this server, so nothing was bought and "
            f"no settings were changed. You can buy {domain} on godaddy.com yourself, then press Resume — "
            "we'll use the domain you own.",
            e.reason,
        ) from e
    try:
        ctx.integ.godaddy.purchase_domain(domain, cost)
    except PurchaseNotSupported as e:
        raise StepBlocked(f"Please buy {domain} on godaddy.com, then press Resume.", str(e)) from e
    mark_used(ctx.session, approval)
    return f"Bought {domain}."


def step_use_app_mailbox(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    if ctx.integ.mailbox.find(ctx.plan.mailbox) is None:
        raise StepFailed("The LaunchWitness inbox isn't set up yet, so we can't receive your orders.",
                         f"app mailbox {ctx.plan.mailbox} not found")
    return f"Orders will arrive at {ctx.plan.mailbox}."


def step_setup_mailbox(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    """Create or adopt; retry creation on failure; poll until ready. Never undone."""
    mb, address, sleep = ctx.integ.mailbox, ctx.plan.mailbox, ctx.integ.sleep
    adopted = mb.find(address) is not None
    if not adopted:
        last = ""
        for attempt in range(1, MAILBOX_CREATE_TRIES + 1):
            try:
                mb.create(address)
                break
            except Exception as e:  # provider busy etc.: retry with backoff
                last = f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"
                audit.record(ctx.session, actor="executor", action="mailbox_create", target=address, result="retry",
                             business_id=ctx.business.id, detail=f"attempt {attempt}: {last}"[:300])
                sleep(2**attempt)
        else:
            raise StepFailed("The email service is busy and couldn't create your mailbox. Press Resume to try again.",
                             last)
    for _ in range(MAILBOX_POLLS):
        if mb.status(address) == "ready":
            return f"{'Using' if adopted else 'Created'} {address}; it's ready."
        sleep(MAILBOX_POLL_SECONDS)
    raise StepFailed("Your mailbox is still being set up. This can take a few minutes — press Resume to keep waiting.",
                     f"{address} not ready after {MAILBOX_POLLS} polls")


def step_email_records(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    for ch in ctx.changes:
        if ch["type"] == "A":
            continue
        after = ch["after"]
        if ch["deferred"] or any(r.get("data") == DKIM_PENDING for r in after):
            name, value = ctx.integ.mailbox.dkim(ctx.plan.zone)
            if name != ch["name"]:
                raise StepFailed("The email service gave an unexpected signing setting. Nothing more was changed.",
                                 f"DKIM name {name} != planned {ch['name']}")
            after = [{**r, "data": value} for r in after]
        write_change(ctx, ch, after)
    return "Email settings added."


def step_wait_dns(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    host, want = ctx.plan.site_host, ctx.settings.server_ip
    for i in range(DNS_POLLS):
        if want in ctx.integ.dns.resolve(host, "A"):
            return f"{host} now points to your website."
        if i < DNS_POLLS - 1:
            ctx.integ.sleep(DNS_POLL_SECONDS)
    raise StepFailed("The internet hasn't picked up the new address yet. This can take up to an hour — "
                     "press Resume to keep waiting.", f"A {host} != {want} after {DNS_POLLS} polls")


def step_go_live(ctx: Ctx) -> str:
    ctx.business.status = "live"
    ctx.session.add(ctx.business)
    ctx.session.commit()
    return f"Your website is on at {ctx.plan.site_host}."


STEPS: dict[str, Callable[[Ctx], str]] = {
    "backup_dns": step_backup_dns,
    "point_site": step_point_site,
    "get_domain": step_get_domain,
    "use_app_mailbox": step_use_app_mailbox,
    "setup_mailbox": step_setup_mailbox,
    "email_records": step_email_records,
    "wait_dns": step_wait_dns,
    "go_live": step_go_live,
}


# ---------- runner ----------

def has_launch_approval(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> bool:
    return session.exec(select(Approval).where(Approval.plan_id == plan.id, Approval.action == "launch")).first() is not None


def _save_steps(session: Session, plan: Plan, steps: list[dict]) -> None:
    plan.steps_json = json.dumps(steps)
    session.add(plan)
    session.commit()


def run_plan(engine: Engine, settings: Settings, integ: Integrations, plan_id: int) -> str:
    """Run (or resume) a plan. Returns the final plan status."""
    with Session(engine) as session:
        plan = session.get(Plan, plan_id)
        if plan is None:
            return "missing"
        business = session.get(Business, plan.business_id)
        if not has_launch_approval(session, plan):
            audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="refused",
                         business_id=plan.business_id, detail="no owner approval")
            return plan.status
        ctx = Ctx(session, settings, integ, plan, business)
        plan.status = "running"
        steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
        _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
        audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="started",
                     business_id=business.id)

        for st in steps:
            if st["status"] in ("done", "skipped"):
                continue
            st.update(status="running", message="", started_at=utcnow().isoformat(), finished_at=None)
            _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
            try:
                message = STEPS[st["kind"]](ctx)
            except StepFailed as e:
                st.update(status=e.status, message=e.message, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
                plan.status = e.status
                _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
                audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host,
                             result=e.status, business_id=business.id, detail=(e.detail or e.message)[:500])
                return plan.status
            except Exception as e:  # unexpected: stop safely, keep details for the log
                st.update(status="failed", finished_at=utcnow().isoformat(),
                          message="Something went wrong while talking to GoDaddy. We stopped here; press Resume to try again.")
                plan.status = "failed"
                _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
                audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host,
                             result="failed", business_id=business.id, detail=f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}"[:500])
                return plan.status
            st.update(status="done", message=message, finished_at=utcnow().isoformat())
            _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
            audit.record(session, actor="executor", action=f"step_{st['kind']}", target=plan.site_host, result="ok",
                         business_id=business.id, detail=message[:500])

        plan.status = "done"
        _save_steps(session, plan, steps)
        audit.record(session, actor="executor", action="run_plan", target=f"plan:{plan.id}", result="ok",
                     business_id=business.id)
        return plan.status


def reset_for_resume(session: Session, plan: Plan) -> None:
    steps = json.loads(plan.steps_json)
    for st in steps:
        if st["status"] in ("failed", "blocked", "running"):
            st.update(status="pending", message="")
    plan.status = "approved"
    _save_steps(session, plan, steps)

USE_FAKES=true (default): one shared in-memory "fake world" per process

class DeliveringFakeMailer(FakeMailer):
    """Practice mode: 'sent' mail lands in the fake inbox, like a working mailbox would."""

    def __init__(self, inbox: FakeInboxReader, sender: str):
        super().__init__()
        self.inbox, self.sender, self.drop = inbox, sender, False

"""Fetch a URL over HTTPS and report status + certificate validity (for launch checks)."""

import ssl
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Protocol
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

import httpx

from app.config import Settings


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class ProbeResult:
    ok: bool  # HTTP 2xx/3xx over HTTPS with a valid certificate
    status: int | None
    cert_valid: bool
    body_snippet: str = ""
    error: str = ""


class HttpProbe(Protocol):
    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult: ...


class RealHttpProbe:
    def __init__(self, timeout: float = 10.0, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None):
        self._http = httpx.Client(timeout=timeout, follow_redirects=True, transport=transport)

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult:
        try:
            r = self._http.get(url)
        except httpx.ConnectError as e:
            cert_bad = isinstance(e.__cause__, ssl.SSLError) or "CERTIFICATE" in str(e).upper()
            return ProbeResult(False, None, not cert_bad, error=type(e).__name__)
        except httpx.HTTPError as e:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, False, error=type(e).__name__)
        https = urlsplit(str(r.url)).scheme == "https"
        return ProbeResult(https and r.status_code < 400, r.status_code, https, r.text[:2000])


class FakeHttpProbe:
    """Practice mode: a site 'is up with a valid certificate' when its host is in the
    fake DNS and not listed in `broken_cert` / `down`."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings | None = None):
        self.down: set[str] = set()
        self.broken_cert: set[str] = set()
        self.calls: list[str] = []

    def fetch(self, url: str) -> ProbeResult:
        self.calls.append(url)
        host = urlsplit(url).hostname or ""
        if host in self.down:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, True, error="ConnectTimeout")
        if host in self.broken_cert:
            return ProbeResult(False, None, False, error="certificate verify failed")
        return ProbeResult(True, 200, True, "<html>ok</html>")
"""GoDaddy REST API wrapper (Domains + DNS). OTE sandbox by default.

DNS writes are always scoped to ONE (type, name) pair (`set_records` /
`delete_records`), never a whole-zone replace, so a launch can't wipe records
it didn't plan. Purchases are not implemented in the real client: they are done
by the owner on godaddy.com, and any future code path must go through
`app.safety.spend_guard.authorize_purchase` first.
"""

from typing import Protocol

import httpx

from app.config import Settings

BASE_URLS = {
    "ote": "https://api.ote-godaddy.com",
    "prod": "https://api.godaddy.com",
}

DnsRecord = dict  # {"type": "A", "name": "@", "data": "1.2.3.4", "ttl": 600, "priority"?: 10}


class PurchaseNotSupported(RuntimeError):
    pass


class GoDaddy(Protocol):
    env: str

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict: ...
    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool: ...
    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]: ...
    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None: ...
    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None: ...
    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict: ...


class GoDaddyClient:
    """Real client. `env` comes from GODADDY_ENV; prod only when set explicitly."""

    def __init__(self, settings: Settings, transport: httpx.BaseTransport | None = None):
        self.env = settings.godaddy_env
        if self.env == "prod":
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_api_key, settings.godaddy_api_secret
        else:
            key, secret = settings.godaddy_ote_api_key, settings.godaddy_ote_api_secret
        self.base_url = BASE_URLS[self.env]
        self._http = httpx.Client(
            base_url=self.base_url,
            headers={
                "Authorization": f"sso-key {key.get_secret_value()}:{secret.get_secret_value()}",
                "Accept": "application/json",
            },
            timeout=20.0,
            transport=transport,
        )

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        r = self._http.get("/v1/domains/available", params={"domain": domain})
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def is_owned(self, domain: str) -> bool:
        """True if the domain is in this GoDaddy account. TODO(real): verify against prod account."""
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}")
        if r.status_code == 404:
            return False
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json().get("status", "").upper() in ("ACTIVE", "PENDING_DNS_ACTIVE", "")

    def get_records(self, domain: str) -> list[DnsRecord]:
        r = self._http.get(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records")
        r.raise_for_status()
        return r.json()

    def set_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str, records: list[DnsRecord]) -> None:
        """Replace all records of one type+name (PUT /v1/domains/{d}/records/{type}/{name})."""
        body = [{k: v for k, v in rec.items() if k not in ("type", "name")} for rec in records]
        r = self._http.put(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}", json=body)
        r.raise_for_status()

    def delete_records(self, domain: str, rtype: str, name: str) -> None:
        r = self._http.delete(f"/v1/domains/{domain}/records/{rtype}/{name}")
        if r.status_code != 404:
            r.raise_for_status()

    def purchase_domain(self, domain: str, price_usd: float) -> dict:
        raise PurchaseNotSupported("Domains are bought by the owner on godaddy.com; the app only adopts them.")

        self.calls: list[tuple] = []
        self.fail_next: dict[str, int] = {}  # method name -> number of upcoming calls that raise

    def _maybe_fail(self, method: str) -> None:
        if self.fail_next.get(method, 0) > 0:
            self.fail_next[method] -= 1
            raise RuntimeError(f"fake {method} failure")

    def check_availability(self, domain: str) -> dict:
        self.calls.append(("check_availability", domain))
        if domain in self.available and domain not in self.owned:
            return {"domain": domain, "available": True, "price_usd": self.available[domain]}

"""M3 acceptance: Namer, Planner, approval, Executor (sandbox + full) against the fake world."""

import json
from pathlib import Path

import pytest
from sqlmodel import Session, select

from app.agents.executor import Ctx, DomainRefused, StepFailed, assert_can_write, run_plan, write_change
from app.agents.namer import clean_names, rank
from app.godaddy.availability import Quote
from app.models import Approval, AuditEvent, Business, DnsBackup, Plan

SELLERS = Path(__file__).parent / "fixtures" / "sellers"


def meera(client, subdomain="meera") -> dict:
    s = json.loads((SELLERS / "meera_cakes.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    biz = client.post("/api/businesses", data={"description": s["description"], "price_list": s["price_list"]}).json()
    r = client.put(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}", json={"profile": biz["profile"], "subdomain": subdomain})
    assert r.status_code == 200
    return r.json()


def plan(client, biz, mode="sandbox", domain=None) -> dict:
    r = client.post(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/plans", json={"mode": mode, "domain": domain})
    assert r.status_code == 201, r.text
    return r.json()


def approve(client, p) -> dict:
    r = client.post(f"/api/plans/{p['id']}/approve", json={"approved_by": "Meera"})
    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
    return client.get(f"/api/plans/{p['id']}").json()


def events(engine, action=None):
    with Session(engine) as s:
        q = select(AuditEvent)
        if action:
            q = q.where(AuditEvent.action == action)
        return s.exec(q).all()


# ---------- Namer ----------

def test_names_are_checked_and_best_three_returned(client, claude, integ):
    biz = meera(client)
    integ.availability.prices = {"meerascakes.in": 8.99, "meerabakes.in": 7.99, "meeracakes.shop": 2.99,
                                 "bakedbymeera.in": 8.99}
    integ.availability.taken = {"meerahomecakes.in"} | {n for n in json.loads(
        Path("tests/fixtures/claude/namer_meera_cakes.json").read_text())["names"] if n not in integ.availability.prices}
    out = client.get(f"/api/businesses/{biz['id']}/names").json()
    assert claude.calls[-1] == "namer_meera_cakes"
    assert out == [{"domain": "meeracakes.shop", "price_usd": 2.99}, {"domain": "meerabakes.in", "price_usd": 7.99},
                   {"domain": "meerascakes.in", "price_usd": 8.99}]
    assert len(integ.availability.calls[0]) == 10


def test_clean_names_drops_junk():
    assert clean_names(["https://www.MeerasCakes.in/", "meeras cakes.in", "x.xyz", "meerascakes.in", 3, "ok-name.com"]) == [
        "meerascakes.in", "ok-name.com"]


def test_rank_prefers_cheap_then_short():
    qs = [Quote("longername.in", True, 5.0), Quote("short.in", True, 5.0), Quote("cheap.shop", True, 1.0),
          Quote("gone.in", False), Quote("x.in", True, 9.0)]
    assert [q.domain for q in rank(qs)] == ["cheap.shop", "short.in", "longername.in"]

    integ.godaddy.zones["localhost"] = [{"type": "A", "name": "meera", "data": "10.0.0.9", "ttl": 600}]
    p = plan(client, meera(client))
    assert p["mode"] == "sandbox" and p["total_cost_usd"] == 0 and p["status"] == "draft"
    assert p["site_host"] == "meera.localhost"
    assert [s["kind"] for s in p["steps"]] == ["backup_dns", "point_site", "use_app_mailbox", "wait_dns", "go_live"]
    (ch,) = p["changes"]
    assert (ch["type"], ch["name"], ch["before_text"], ch["after_text"]) == ("A", "meera", ["10.0.0.9"], [settings.server_ip])
